parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The product description. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as one character.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product. This is the globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the product.

You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

parameters.name: ProductName
parameters.description:
The new product name.
The product name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). A Chinese character counts as two characters.

><notice> The product name must be unique within the current instance.
></notice>
